title: Aspectual Preverbs of Endurance and Prevailing (végig-, felül-, helyt-)

sections.title: Endurance Preverbs in Strenuous Circumstances
sections.content: The preverb 'végig-' attached to telic verbs specifies completing a strenuous duration without surrender: 'végigküzd egy mérkőzést' (fights through an entire match), 'végigállja a próbát' (stands the trial to the very end). This aspectual prefix highlights perseverance through pain or adversity.

sections.title: Overcoming Adversity: felülkerekedik and helytáll
sections.content: Key institutional verbs of triumph include 'felülkerekedik valamin' (governing the superessive case -on/-en/-ön: to prevail over something) and 'helytáll valahol' (to stand one's ground / hold one's own). These verbs are essential when narrating historical crises where physical victory symbolizes moral vindication.

sections.title: Verbs of Endurance and Triumph
rows: A sportolók végigküzdötték a kemény összecsapást.
The athletes fought through the harsh clash to the end.
A csapat sikeresen felülkerekedett a nehézségeken.
The team successfully prevailed over the difficulties.
A magyarok méltósággal helytálltak a világ előtt.
The Hungarians stood their ground with dignity before the world.

items.spanish: A válogatott tagjai olyannyira elszántak voltak, hogy a lelki trauma ellenére végigküzdötték a tornát.
items.english: The members of the national team were so determined that despite psychological trauma they fought through the tournament to the end.

items.spanish: A fegyelmezett magyar pólósok sportszerűségükkel kerekedtek felül az ellenfél durvaságán.
items.english: The disciplined Hungarian water polo players prevailed over the opponent's roughness with their sportsmanship.

items.spanish: A forradalom leverése után a sportolók példamutatóan álltak helyt az ausztráliai játékokon.
items.english: After the crushing of the revolution, the athletes held their ground exemplarily at the Australian games.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Remember case government: 'felülkerekedik' always requires -on/-en/-ön (felülkerekedik az ellenfelén, a fáradtságon); 'helytáll' is an intransitive verb with preverb 'helyt'.
